title: Sign in
descriptionLocal: Local dev mode — pick any user and role set to mint a session against the running stack.
descriptionCognito: Use your Cognito account to access the OCI Platform.
expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
policies: Signing in agrees to the GI-AI4H platform’s data-handling policies.
cognitoHint: You’ll be redirected to your organisation’s Cognito sign-in.

local.userHint: Any string. The UUID-shaped user maps cleanly to identity.users.id; non-UUIDs are derived deterministically (PR D).
local.rolesHint: Comma-separated. Try host, admin, participant, regulator, supervisor.
